name: tokenwise
description: Reporting-only companion to the LEAPWare TokenWise Claude Code plugin. Same policy engine and rules, surfaced through skills rather than an enforcing hook — see skills/tokenwise-report and docs/install-codex.md for why.

interface.shortDescription: Token-policy reporting for this session (reporting-only on Codex).
interface.longDescription: tokenwise makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. On Claude Code it also enforces via a hook; on Codex it currently ships reporting-only (see docs/install-codex.md) — the same policy engine, surfaced through the tokenwise-config and tokenwise-report skills.
interface.defaultPrompt: tokenwise: show the current token policy and report on the last action.
